posts.author: Alexander Joseph Maturino
posts.body:
Hello! I am relatively new talking here, but I want to ask for help looking for a specific game I have in my head that I have seen and possibly played in the past.
Although I am not 100% sure, I am quite positive that the game I am looking for was made in an RPG Maker engine based the gameplay that I remember. The game starts off with the player in perspective of a male character wanting to rob a helpless and defenseless person (old lady I think) to get enough money to buy medicine for his gravely ill loved one whom I believe is the character's mother if I recall correctly. Shortly after this, I think he gets run over by a vehicle.
I clearly recall a long descent after as the screen pans down and your character is sent to hell. Your task is to look around the hellish landscape and find a way to go back to the living to save your gravely ill loved one. If I remember correctly, you have to look around and find collectibles (stars I think) to find your way out of hell and return to the living. I do not recall much of the ending, but I do know near the beginning of the game that there is a sound of a woman screaming as a jumpscare to greet you starting out. I am sure that the game has a sequel as well, though I'm positive that the details I mention is regarding the first game.
I estimate that the game was around when RPG Maker VX Ace was newly released and I fondly recall browsing around RPG Maker dot net for new games to play, which is why I believe this game was made with RPG Maker. Any help or info would be very much appreciated and I hope I posted this in the correct area!
